_about: Per-rule precision ledger (docs/precision.md). Built by tools/precision_ledger.py from label files; do not edit by hand. A rule is admitted when its Wilson 95% lower bound reaches bar.rule_lower on at least bar.rule_min_n TP+FP labels, with labeller kappa at least bar.kappa_min where two labellers looked. `tier` is the claim: verified-tier precision on held-out labels only, stratified by (rule, source, language) and weighted by each stratum's population, overall and per category.

multiplicity.about: ARB-171: exact one-sided binomial test of H0 precision <= bar per rule, adjusted over the family (rules with >= rule_min_n held-out labels), overall and per language. Reported beside admission; admission is unchanged. docs/precision.md
multiplicity.family: rules with >= rule_min_n decided held-out labels
multiplicity.counts: all decided labels (as admission); held_out = sensitivity
